title: rubus alterniflorus subsp. stereobelus
intro: Rubus alterniflorus subsp. stereobelus, commonly known as the Himalayan raspberry, is a plant species found in the Himalayan region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus alterniflorus subsp. stereobelus are attributed to its ability to inhibit enzymes involved in carbohydrate and lipid metabolism, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which may contribute to its health-promoting effects.
